references.text: Israel's rebellion at Kadesh-Barnea where the people refused to enter the land and rebelled against the Lord's command
Joshua and Caleb urge the people not to rebel against the Lord
Moses reminds how Israel was disobedient and did not trust the Lord when he sent them from Kadesh-Barnea
The psalmist describes how Israel despised the glorious land, did not believe in the Lord's word, but grumbled in their tents and did not obey the Lord's voice
Israel's rebellion against the Holy Spirit of the Lord and how they became his enemies
Ezekiel describes how Israel rebelled against the Lord and would not listen to him
The letter to the Hebrews refers to the generation that rebelled after hearing God's voice and was not allowed to enter rest because of disobedience
Reference to those who first heard the gospel preached but did not enter because of disobedience
